`Files/increment` を先に作っておく理由は 2 つあります。第: There are two reasons to create `Files/increment` first. The OneLake FileCreated trigger in section 12.2 cannot select `/Files/increment` until that folder exists. Keeping it empty lets you place the first file after the formal start operation and verify that only the uploaded file was ingested. Placing incremental CSVs now would add files before the trigger exists, so the gate in section 12.4 would not be satisfied.
